n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

N = 505
C = [[0] * (N) for _ in range(N)]
f = [0] * N
g = [0] * N
ff = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
gg = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]

def add(x, y):
    x[0] += y
    if x[0] >= mod:
        x[0] -= mod

# Precompute binomial coefficients
for i in range(n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod

f[0] = 1
g[0] = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        temp1 = (f[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod
        temp2 = (g[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod
        temp3 = (g[i - j] * f[j - 1]) % mod
        s = 0
        for k in range(1, i + 1):
            s += abs(k - j)
        s %= mod
        add([f[i]], (temp1 * C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1)) % mod)
        add([g[i]], (temp2 * C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1)) % mod)
        add([g[i]], (temp3 * C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1)) % mod)
        add([g[i]], (f[j - 1] * f[i - j] * C[i - 1][j - 1] * s) % mod)

# Initialize ff and gg
ff[0][0] = 1
gg[0][0] = 0

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, i + 1):
        if j == i:
            ff[i][j] = f[i]
            gg[i][j] = g[i]
            continue
        ff[i][j] = ff[i - 1][j]
        gg[i][j] = gg[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            add([ff[i][j]], (ff[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k] * C[j][k]) % mod)
            add([gg[i][j]], (ff[i - k - 1][j - k] * g[k] * C[j][k]) % mod)
            add([gg[i][j]], (gg[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k] * C[j][k]) % mod)

print(gg[n][m])
